scope: 30 Olmo3 runs: the eight selection methods of the main table, No Debiasing, and BM25 with signed rollouts.
run_id: Name of the original experiment directory, or the row number in the source table.
precision: Values keep the precision of the source metric files. BM25 with signed rollouts was recorded at two decimals.

aggregation.Validation_source: arithmetic mean of BBH, MBPP_plus, MATH, MMLU_Pro
aggregation.Additional: arithmetic mean of ZebraLogic, LCB_v5, OlympiadBench, GPQA_D
aggregation.All: arithmetic mean of the eight benchmark scores
aggregation.standard_deviation: sample standard deviation across three runs (ddof=1); aggregate metrics are calculated within each run first
aggregation.BBH: micro average over 18 subtasks and 4,365 questions

notes: Source paths are relative to the experiment archive. A ** segment stands for a model-path directory. The metric files themselves are not bundled.
The starting checkpoint is not included. It is evaluated once and has no training runs.

rows.note: Assembled from dispersed files whose recorded model is the same olmo_uniform_safe checkpoint-500; stochastic benchmarks use their declared repeated-sampling files.
Uses eval_output_olmes_0424 explicitly, excluding the separate greedy evaluation.
